notes: Never installed a breaker after Carmen and never contested Server 1, where the Corp scored four agendas; spent many clicks re-running HQ through Congratulations! to see the same cards, and declined to pay Loot Box's 2 credits while able.
Won by pressuring remotes and HQ, but repeatedly ran into Karuna with no money to break it, taking 4 net damage at a time and losing Utae, and never used the Leech counters.
Re-ran HQ to see the same Hedge Funds, then clicked for credits for seven straight turns up to 32 credits with a full grip, never contesting the remote agendas.
Solid economy and R&D pressure to reach 6 points, but ignored a revealed agenda (Superconducting Hub) in a lightly iced remote and the advanced card in Server 1 that won the Corp the game.
Fast, sensible win built on HQ and R&D pressure and a timely remote check; the only oddity is a redundant end-of-turn HQ run.

Ran R&D a dozen times through Ansel 1.0, whose unbroken 'cannot steal' sub made every run pointless, lost all programs, installed a second unique Pennyshaver that was trashed at once, and let the Corp score repeatedly from Server 3/4.
Quick win off HQ and R&D pressure with reasonable breaker use; spending the last 2 credits to clear a tag was a minor inefficiency.
Clicked for credits for 13 turns to 65 credits with a full grip, never installing a breaker or contesting any remote while the Corp scored out.
Ran unprotected R&D four times a turn to see the same top card, installed nothing all game, and left the remotes alone, including a naked install-and-score.
Won through steady R&D pressure, but trashed its own Boi-tata to Abaasy, ran Bathynomus broke at near-flatline hand size, and spent many turns clicking for credits.
Won thanks to good Tao swaps and R&D steals, but piled up tags running Funhouse broke, re-ran HQ for the same cards, and let three Embedded Reportings score from Server 1 unchallenged.
Made only one slow R&D run per turn for many turns while the Corp sat idle at 5 points, then ran R&D instead of the newly installed Server 1 card that won the Corp the game.
Trashed its only breaker for Spec Work, then hoarded 38 credits by clicking while the Corp scored from lightly defended remotes.
After a strong start, bounced off Tatu-Bola dozens of times with no breaker for it, installed duplicate unique cards, and finally flatlined itself running Anemone with an empty grip.
Coherent win with good Archives and remote pressure; the main risk was facechecking Saisentan into a 5-card loss, plus an idle clicking turn.
Pinhole Threading reached Architect Deployment Test but the Runner declined to steal it despite 27 credits, then hoarded money without a way past Hagen while the Corp scored out of Server 4.
Built a pile of Leech counters and never used them, made repeated empty Archives runs, and with the Corp at 6 points let the final agenda in Server 1 score without a run despite 17 credits.
Ran open HQ four times instead of the turn-one remote agenda, then clicked for credits for ten turns to 53 credits without installing anything.
Won with R&D pressure and a well-timed Docklands HQ run, but kept running R&D into Vertigo's no-steal effect and facechecked a four-ice remote, losing Red Team to Ansel.
Ran open R&D four times a turn for the same card, then ran Vasilisa broke dozens of times taking tags, never played its grip, and spent its last turns paying to clear tags while the Corp scored out.
